translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yaak'oobi Beeteele Simmeedda
S'oossay hewaappe guyye Yaak'ooba, «Denddaade pude Beeteele baade yan de'a. Neeni ne ishaa Eesaappe bak'atiyaa wode new k'onc'c'eedda S'oossaw yan yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'a» yaageedda.
Yaak'oobi bare soo asaanne barenana de'iyaawantta ubbaa, «hinttenttu gidduwaan de'iyaa allaga S'oossatuwaa misiletuwaa diggite; hinttenttu bollaa geeshshite; hinttenttu mayuwaanne laammite.
Ane denddiide, pude Beeteele boytte; ta metuwaa gallassi taana siseedda, taani beedda sa'aan ubbaan taananna gideedda S'oossaw, taani yan yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'ana» yaageedda.

Hewaa diraw unttunttu barenttoo de'iyaa allaga s'oossatuwaa misiletuwaa ubbaanne barenttu haytsaan de'iyaa gudichchaa ubbaa Yaak'oobaw immeeddino; Yaak'oobi hewantta Sekeeman de'iyaa wolaa garssan moogeedda.

Hewaappe guyye, Yaak'oobinne Aa attuma naanay denddiide biishshin, itti uraynne unttuntta oyk'k'anaw kaallibeenna; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu biishshin, unttunttu yuushshuwaan de'iyaa katamaa asaa ubbaa bolla S'oossaa dagamay wod'd'eedda.
Yaak'oobinne aanana de'iyaa Asay ubbay Kanaane gadiyaan de'iyaa (Beeteele giyaa) Looza gakkeeddino.
Yan I yarshshiyaa sa'aa kees's'eedda; I he sa'aa El-Beeteele giide suntseedda; ayaw gooppe, I bare ishaappe bak'atiide biyaa wode, S'oossay aw k'onc'c'eedda sa'ay hewaa.
Ribik'o dichchiyaa Deboora yan hayk'k'aaddu; Beeteeleppe hirkkinna de'iyaa wolaa garssan iza moogettaaddu; hewaa diraw he mitsaa suntsay Yeekuwaa Wolaa geetetteedda.
Yaak'oobi Masp'p'es'oomiyaappe simmeeddawaappe guyye, S'oossay aw zaaretsi k'onc'c'iide, Aa anjjeedda;
S'oossay Aa, «Ne suntsay Yaak'ooba; shin hawaappe sintsanaw neeni ubbakka Yaak'ooba geetettakka; ne suntsay israa'eeliyaa gidana» yaagiide I Aa israa'eeliyaa suntseedda.
K'ay S'oossay Yaak'ooba, «Taani Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaa; neeni yeletta; c'oratta; kawutetsatuunne kawutetsaa Asay neeppe kessana; kaatetuukka ne gulbbataappe kessana.
Taani Abrahaamewunne Yisaak'aw immeedda biittaa, k'ay new immay; neeppe guyyenna taani ha biittaa ne zeretsaw immana» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye, S'oossay aanana haasayeedda sa'aappe pude kesseedda.
Yaak'oobi S'oossay barenana haasayeedda sa'aan shuchchaa essiide, Aa bolla ushshaa yarshshuwaa tigeedda; zayitiyaakka bolla tigeedda.
Yaak'oobi S'oossay barenana haasayeedda sa'aa «Beeteele» giide suntseedda.
Raaheelinne Yisaak'a Hayk'k'uwaa
Unttunttu hewaappe guyye, Beeteeleppe denddeeddino. Unttunttu Efiraataa gakkanaw laafaa ashshiyaa wode, Raaheelo yeluu oyk'k'eedda; yeluwaan iza loytsa waayettaaddu.
Yeluu izo waayisseedda wode izo yelissiyaana, «Yayyoppa; hawekka attuma na'aa» yaagaaddu.
Shin iza hayk'k'aadde, shemppu kesishshin, bare na'aa Been"oona
suntsaaddu; shin Aa aawuu Aa Biiniyaama
suntseedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Raaheela hayk'k'a bashaaddu; Beeteleeme giyaa Efiraataa afiyaa ogiyaa doonaan moogettaaddu.
Yaak'oobi izi duufuwaan hawulttiyaa shuchchaa esseedda; he hawulttii hachche gakkanaw Raaheeli duufuwaa erissee.
Israa'eelii hewaappe denddiide, Edera gimbbiyaappe hefintsaan bare dunkkaaniyaa tokkeedda.
Israa'eelii he gadiyaan de'ishshin, Roobeeli biide, bare aawoo yeleedda k'oomatti Baalina giseedda. Israa'eelii ha yewuwaa siseedda. Yaak'ooba attuma naanay tammanne laa"a.
Liya naanay Yaak'ooba bayira na'aa Roobeela, Simoona, Leewa, Yihudaa, Yisaakooranne Zaabiloona.
Raaheeli attuma naanay Yooseefanne Biiniyaama.
Raaheeli danggaas'iratti Baali attuma naanay Daananne Nifttaaleema.
Liya danggaas'iratti Zilppi attuma naanay Gaadanne Aaseera. Hawanttu Masp'p'es'oomiyaan Yaak'oobaw yeletteedda Aa attuma naanaa.
Yaak'oobi (Kebroona giyaa) K'iriyaati-Arbba'a matan Maamiren de'iyaa, bare aawuwaa Yisaak'a soo yeedda; he sa'ay kase Abrahaamenne Yisaak'i de'eedda sa'aa.
Yisaak'i s'eetanne hosppun tammu laytsaa de'eedda;
I daro wodiyaa de'iide, lo"o c'imi hayk'k'iidde bare mayzzan gaketeedda. Aa naanay Eesaynne Yaak'oobi Aa moogeeddino.

footnotes.text: Been"oona: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Ta metuwaa na'aa» giyaawaa.
Biiniyaama: Ha suntsaa biletsay Ibraaweetsuwaan, «Ta ushechcha Kushiyaa na'aa» giyaawaa.
